name: OpenDNS public resolvers (Cisco Umbrella, RFC 8484 DoH)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted). The terms class stays 'unknown' until legal records them (P020 cond 2).

reliability.justification: Cisco Umbrella threat intelligence behind the standard resolver; blocked names answer the block-page range 146.112.61.104-110 (per-address category unverified).

standard.title: OpenDNS standard resolver (doh.opendns.com, RFC 8484 wire format): security block verdicts

terms.quote: Opt-in module protective_dns_extra (default_enabled=False) holds AdGuard (dns.adguard-dns.com, family.adguard-dns.com), OpenDNS (doh.opendns.com) and CleanBrowsing. AdGuard and OpenDNS stay terms 'unknown' until legal records their terms

standard.notes: Quote: binding council text (P020 cond 2). Category security, 'OpenDNS standard' (cond 4). Wire format only through dnspython (cond 3).
